annotations.title: Can Taseli reach the form leads

description: Read only. For each Meta account: whether Taseli may build instant forms, whether it reads their leads into the Leads page, whether new leads arrive within a minute, and per Facebook Page whether Meta lets Taseli read its leads. When something is missing, the one step that opens it, in the owner's language, ready to forward to whoever manages the business in Meta. Useful for 'why don't my form leads show?', 'can you make a lead form?'.

account.description: An ad account's name or id, to see one account only; omit for all of them.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.

name: lead_access_status

forms.description: open, reconnect (the owner reconnects Meta once), not_yet or read_only.

instant.description: New form leads arrive within a minute.

anyOf.description: What opens it, in the owner's language.

state.description: ok, needs_leads_access, no_task, platform_off or unknown.

anyOf.description: The one step that opens the most, in the owner's language.

note.description: A plain note instead of data (nothing connected yet, not available here).
